pages.text: The extra Techguns slots are $(thing)Curios$() slots. Open them with the Curios button in the survival inventory.

pages.title: Additional Armor Slots
pages.text: Special items are worn in the Curios $(thing)'Head'$(), $(thing)'Back'$() and $(thing)'Hands'$() slots, for example gas masks, jetpacks and gloves. Items in these slots give different abilities or bonus stats.

pages.title: Ammo Slots
pages.text: There are also 8 Curios $(thing)'Ammo'$() slots, so ammo does not clutter the inventory. Every item that is used as ammo or battery can be put there. Reloading checks for ammo in the ammo inventory first, empty magazines and batteries also get put there first.

pages.title: Food Slots
pages.text: The 3 food slots allow to store food items that automatically get eaten when needed. Automatic feeding can be disabled in the config file.

pages.title: Toggle Buttons
pages.text: Bonus effects like 'Nightvision', 'Step-Assist', 'Jetpacks' and 'Safe Mode' are toggled with keybinds, see the Techguns category in the controls options. The $(l:tg_hud#images)Techguns HUD$(/l) shows which ones are active.
